turns.text: generate token first gave ABDM-9999 user not found, i retried and now it says ABDM-1092 duplicate link token request. so did the first one go through?

must_contain: The duplicate refusal does not mean the first request worked: ABDM refused it and remembered the refusal.
The first refusal, ABDM-9999 user not found, is the one that names the cause, and a retry inside the deduplication window cannot succeed.
notes: Observed on sandbox 2026-09-16 per the atom's source. The wrong answer reads 'duplicate' as success. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/concepts/m2-retry-is-a-duplicate.md, 'ABDM records a link token request even when it refuses the patient, and deduplicates the next identical request against the one it refused. So a retry inside that window cannot succeed'; table rows '`400`, `ABDM-9999`, user not found' and '`400`, `ABDM-1092`, duplicate link token request'; 'A duplicate refusal is read as evidence that the first request succeeded. It is not. The first was refused, and ABDM remembered the refusal.'; 'say that the earlier refusal is the one that names the cause'.
